'''''The Balance''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was owned by the [[Almas Academy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
''The Balance'' was created by [[Matthew Domville]] and featured in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] scenario ''[[Forces of Cularin: Force Convention|Force Convention]]''. During the adventure, if the player characters lack a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of their own, then [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] lends them the use of ''The Balance''.
